text: Keep delete highlighting in rendered aim UI state
description: Delete confirmation/highlight in recursive list views belongs to the rendered AimUIState, like expanded, rather than a global aim-ID flag. Graph confirmation remains graph-scoped.

reflections.context: Delete confirmation was stored globally by aim ID although an aim can be rendered recursively in multiple list locations.
reflections.outcome: Moved pendingDelete into AimUIState, updated keyboard/navigation clearing, removed it from the list store, and isolated graph confirmation in graph UI state. Added regression tests.
reflections.effectiveness: Focused Vitest run passes 7/7. Frontend type-check is currently stopped by the repository's existing TypeScript 6 baseUrl deprecation configuration before source checking.
reflections.lesson: Ephemeral interaction feedback should be owned at the same rendering scope as expansion/selection; view-specific confirmation must not leak through a shared domain-ID flag.

status.comment: Implemented and internally verified; awaiting user acceptance.
